arguments.title: Tidewater Digital interview: Hana Iqbal, account manager (2026-10-05)

process_json.name: Monthly client report
process_json.description: Month end to a reviewed report in the client's inbox. Retainer terms promise the report within five working days of month end (40 h at 8 h a day); that promise belongs on the service's servicing link in Settings.

assumptions.reasoning: Hana says of the pull 'It just gets done': the data lands in the shared folder and she gets a ping. No wait is described, so 0.
Nobody says the ranking pull is sent back. Hana mentions the tracker export timing out about once a fortnight but declines to guess its cost, so 0 here; Owen is the person to ask.

steps.name: Write commentary
steps.notes: Hana: two hours in a quiet month, three when something has dropped and needs explaining.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: I've got four half-written right now

assumptions.reasoning: The ranking data 'lands in the shared folder' and Hana gets a ping, so nothing is described as delaying the start of writing: 0.
Hana says Callum sends reports back to her, which is modelled as Director review's rework going to this step, so this step has no rework of its own: 0.

steps.name: Director review
steps.notes: Callum Reid reviews every report. Hana: 'It sits in Callum's inbox a day or two, because he's always in meetings.' That is queueing behind his other work, which the engine simulates, so it is a timing note and not a wait.

assumptions.reasoning: Hana does not know ('You'd have to ask him') but says he reads fast. 0.5 h is a guess for reading one report and editing the wording: longer than Send report (0.25) and far shorter than writing it (2.5). Ask Callum.
The day or two in Callum's inbox is queueing, which the engine simulates from his workload, so no fixed wait is added: 0.

steps.name: Send report
steps.notes: Routing: Hana at 00:04:38 said 'But about one in ten has questions, and then it turns into a follow-up call.' So 0.1 goes to Follow-up call and 0.9 to Report sent. The app keeps no evidence on routing.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: A quarter of an hour, tops

assumptions.reasoning: Exporting to PDF and emailing happen straight away: 0.
Nothing comes back to this step; client questions are modelled as routing to Follow-up call: 0.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: Half an hour. Sometimes it runs over but it's half an hour in the diary.

assumptions.reasoning: Hana describes the call as booked in the diary; no wait is described, so 0.
A follow-up call does not send the report back to an earlier step: 0.

arguments.name: Priti Rao

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: she's three days a week now

arguments.note: Hana says Priti is now three days a week, since the start of the month: 3 of 5 days is 0.6 FTE.

arguments.name: Jonah Pike

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: we've hired Jonah Pike, he's an SEO specialist, he starts on the twelfth of October

arguments.note: New hire, SEO specialist, starting 12 October 2026. FTE was not stated, so it takes the default of 1.

arguments.name: Marlow Physio

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: they were twenty-five hundred a month but they're on twenty-nine hundred now, because they took the content add-on as well as the SEO retainer

arguments.note: Was 2500, now 2900 a month with both services.

arguments.name: Quayside Vets

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: Quayside Vets, they signed on the SEO retainer. I'm their account manager and Owen's doing the SEO

arguments.note: New client on the SEO retainer. Monthly fee not stated: Hana says it was Callum's deal.

lead_sources.name: Referrals

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: It's about three a week now, it was two for ages and it's crept up

lead_sources.note: Referrals were 2 a week and are now about 3.
